characteristics.name: Melee Attacks
characteristics.$text:
Two-Handed: [RED][YELLOW]
[HELMET]: Bleed
[SWORDS]: add [GREEN]
Cumbersome, Two-Handed Block

rules.name: Devastating Assault
rules.description: When Butcher is the Party Champion, friendly models within 6" of Butcher that benefit from the Bandit's Strength in Numbers [rule] may choose to add [RED] to their Melee Attacks instead of [GREEN].

rules.name: Imperial Enmity (1)
rules.description: When targeting a model with the Imperial Legion Faction [icon] with an Attack, Rigel may reroll the Skill Die [once] if she fails to hit.

rules.name: Little Sabrecat
rules.description: When Rigel inflicts damage via a Melee Attack, she gains the Piercing (2) keyword in addition to any [other] special effects [and] all friendly Bandit Faction models within 6" yet to activate add Piercing (1) to their Attacks for the rest of the round.

rules.name: Knife in the Belly
rules.description: When targeting a model with the Imperial Legion Faction [icon] with an Attack, Rigel may reroll the Skill Die if she fails to hit.

rules.name: Gangmaster
rules.description: When Haldyn is the Party Champion, friendly Followers within 3" of Butcher that benefit from the Bandit's Strength in Numbers rule [add] [YELLOW] to their Melee Attacks in addition to the usual [GREEN].

rules.name: Brutal Leader
rules.description: When a friendly Bandit Faction model within 3" is forced to Flee, you may instead remove the fleeing model from play as a casualty.  This model and all friendly Bandit Faction models within 6" yet to activate add [YELLOW] to their Attacks for the rest of the round.

rules.name: Brigand
rules.description: If this model removes an enemy as a casualty [as a result of] a Melee Attack and that enemy possessed any Treasure Cards when it was removed, roll the Skill die. On a [CRITICAL HIT], gain 1 bonus VP.
